queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'pending' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'confirmed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS confirmed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'completed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completed, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS cancelled, SUM(CASE WHEN bill_status = 'unpaid' AND status != 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpaid, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN bill_status = 'paid' THEN bill_amount ELSE 0 END), 0) AS revenue FROM `appointments`
